203 days from 1299-03-08.  
1299 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but year < 1582, but for Gregorian arithmetic we apply proleptic Gregorian rules: 1299 mod 4 = 3, so not leap).  
March has 31 days, so days left in March after 8th: 31 - 8 = 23 days.  
203 - 23 = 180 days left after March.  
April (30) → 150 left, May (31) → 119 left, June (30) → 89 left, July (31) → 58 left, August (31) → 27 left, September (30) → goes into September.  
September 27th is the date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1299-09-27
